description: Hardened Hybrid Gaussian-Copula/Hurdle Generative Architecture for SH-405

age.rationale: Empirical survey sampling distribution over ages 8-80; captures multi-modal survey demographics without boundary violations.

sex.rationale: Binary indicator for male (1) vs female (2).

diabetes.rationale: Latent thresholding at Phi^{-1}(1 - p) with biserial correlation calibration to prevent correlation attenuation without ad-hoc rank forcing.

systolic_bp.rationale: Strictly positive, right-skewed physiological blood pressure distribution.

diastolic_bp.rationale: Truncated Normal ensuring strictly positive diastolic blood pressure.

activity_mims.rationale: Truncated Normal ensuring non-negative physical activity monitor counts.

n_medications.rationale: Discrete count distribution preserving exact zero-inflation (52.2%) and integer support.

adherence_pct.rationale: Truncated Normal on [0, 100]; empirical data spans [5.0, 95.0] with zero boundary masses.

pain_score.rationale: Two-part hurdle with conditional PIT mapping positive pain magnitude through the joint latent Gaussian copula.
